description: This file defines the Log class, a helper utility for logging within an Android project. It provides static methods for logging at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a chain of LogNode instances to handle log message output. It also defines constants that mirror android.util.Log levels and provides methods to set and get the LogNode.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, managing a chain of LogNode objects, and serving as a stand-in for Android's Log.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional exception.
